summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (Book 2, part 11) in which narrator Cas Russell, after a phone call with Rio, who is working undercover and wants no help, calls information broker Anton of Mack's Garage to research the word "Pithica" that may link to Colombian drug runners. Cas then drives Courtney through Los Angeles traffic on the 405 freeway in the heat, with Courtney's cash situation raised as a question.
one_line: Cas Russell, suspicious that Rio is working undercover, hires information broker Anton to dig up anything on "Pithica" while driving Courtney through LA traffic.
key_facts: Narrator Cas Russell believes Rio is still undercover and was surprised he did not simply take down the gang.
Rio ended the phone call with the words "God be with you" and hung up.
Rio's usual method, as the narrator describes it, was to go in, hurt the people who needed hurting, and get out.
Rio had referred Dawna to Cas to get Courtney out, rather than doing it himself.
Anton answers the phone at Mack's Garage with a gravelly voice.
Cas asks Anton to find everything he can on the word "Pithica".
Cas suspects "Pithica" may have ties to Colombian drug runners and that the authorities might already be investigating.
Anton is one of several information brokers in the city whom Cas has hired over the past couple of years.
Anton promises results in two hours and charges his usual rates.
Cas and Courtney drive on the 405 freeway in Southern California during rush hour.
The temperature rose by a full thirty-four degrees Fahrenheit with the rising sun as they headed into Los Angeles.
Cas asks Courtney whether she has cash or whether her money is all in the bank.
Cas and Courtney's car is described as a junkpot car.
